Cloud Security Engineer

at Umbrella Security Corp · Singapore · Hybrid

We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own posture management across AWS and Azure estates. You will drive vulnerability management programs, harden Kubernetes clusters, and partner with platform teams on secure defaults.

About you: 6+ years of experience in security engineering, deep knowledge of IAM and network security, and comfort writing Python for automation. CISSP or equivalent certification is a plus.

We offer health insurance, 20 days of PTO, and an annual bonus. Salary: $110,000-$140,000.

Apply before the deadline; this posting is open to all candidates with the right to work in Singapore.
